title: Charro Lasso Roping
tagline: Spin the loop to the beat, then rope the running horse
description: The Mexican rope art on your phone: tap the knots on the beat through six named tricks, then hold and throw the loop to settle it over a painted target rolling down the rail. Three levels, a rival charro, Hints and a full Auto Play.
howToPlay: Tap anywhere as each knot meets the gold ring.
Hold the long bars and let go when they reach the ring.
Hits in a row build a multiplier up to x4.
On a run, press and hold to grow the loop, then let go to throw.
A dashed ring shows where the target will be when the loop lands.
The charro with the higher total wins the event.
